The 4-position SUN/MOON preamp voicing selector offers a distinctive pallet of tones ranging from brilliant sparkling detail to warm and harmonically rich. Using the BODY and AIR controls, fine-tuning the sonic character is easy and intuitive. Dial in BODY to add thickness and tighten the low-end. Add AIR to bring out the high-end shimmer and detail in your guitar’s pickups. GIGGITY can either be placed at the front of the pedal chain like a classic overdrive or at the end, working like a front end of an amp. Each GIGGITY is crafted with premium components and features silent, true bypass switching. $ 199.99 In stock GIGGITY® Analog Overdrive + Preamp quantity ADD TO CART   FIND A DEALER Giggity Features SUN/MOON dial selects from four distinct preamp/gain voicings BODY & AIR controls fine-tune preamp sonic character Plexi Top Panel True Bypass via high-reliability gold-contact relay 5-year warranty* Giggity Specifications Dimensions 4.75” x 3.75” x 2” (121 x 95 x 51mm) Weight 1.15 lbs. (520g) Power Requirements 9V DC, 35mA Power Input Type 5.5mm x 2.1mm barrel connector, center negative polarity Product ID VG *Warranty 5-year limited warranty in North America. Please contact your region's authorized Voodoo Lab distributor for warranty service outside North America. GIGGITY CONTROLS LOUDNESS – Sets the input gain for Giggity’s preamp section. Use low settings for clean sounds, or turn it all the way up for a little grit and compression. SUN/MOON SELECTOR – Four-position control that selects the overall gain structure and voicing of Giggity’s preamp section. SUN adds shimmering high-end. MOON adds weight and warmth. BODY – Boosts or cuts your signal’s lower midrange/upper bass frequencies. With the knob at 12 o’clock (which is equal to 0dB of cut or boost), turn it clockwise to add Body. Turning the knob counter-clockwise cuts the Body frequencies AIR – Boosts or cuts the higher treble frequencies of your signal. With the knob at 12 o’clock (which is equal to 0dB of cut or boost), turn it clockwise to add shimmer and presence. Turning the knob counter-clockwise cuts the Air frequencies. MASTER – Sets the overall output level.
